question: Why should CereVasc buy this rather than simply build an incremental drug-delivery modification internally?

advantages.description: Turns eShunt from drainage device into exposure-controlled therapeutic platform
advantages.evidence: 327% tissue exposure improvement (model-derived, structurally robust across 8 formulations)
advantages.why_not_build_internally: CereVasc's existing US11850390B2 covers delivery but NOT spatial separation or retention. Internal development would require the same R&D.

advantages.description: Controlled exposure makes eShunt attractive to pharma partners (predictable PK → easier clinical trials)
advantages.evidence: CereVasc publicly seeking pharma partners (EXTERNAL_EVIDENCE); controlled exposure is a pharma trial requirement
advantages.why_not_build_internally: The IP position (spatial separation claim) blocks competitors from offering the same exposure control.

advantages.description: Acquiring the spatial separation IP + validated PK model saves ~12-18 months of internal R&D
advantages.evidence: The PK model, architecture, and validation blueprint are pre-built; CereVasc inherits them
advantages.why_not_build_internally: Internal development would start from scratch: architecture selection, PK modeling, ablation, validation design.

advantages.description: Spatial separation claim blocks competitors from the eShunt-specific exposure control territory
advantages.evidence: 102 SURVIVES on 7 limitations; spatial separation is eShunt-specific (4 unique technical effects)
advantages.why_not_build_internally: If CereVasc doesn't acquire this, a competitor could patent spatial separation and block CereVasc's own follow-on products.

advantages.description: Spatial separation benefits any drug with high CSF clearance (small molecules, biologics, gene therapy vectors)
advantages.evidence: PK model shows 327% improvement for 150 kDa agent; mechanism (spatial gradient) is MW-independent
advantages.why_not_build_internally: Platform applies across therapeutic classes — one IP covers multiple drug partnerships.

advantages.description: 327% more tissue exposure for same dose, or same exposure for 1/3 the dose
advantages.evidence: Monte Carlo (N=500): median 327%, 5th percentile 109%, 100% threshold met
advantages.warning: C3 tissue concentration does NOT reach bevacizumab therapeutic threshold (0.001 mg/mL). The 327% AUC improvement is a PHARMACOKINETIC PROXY, not demonstrated therapeutic benefit.
advantages.why_not_build_internally: The PK model, ablation, and validation blueprint are ready for immediate execution.

net_assessment: CereVasc should buy this because: (1) the IP blocks competitors from the spatial separation territory, (2) the PK model + validation blueprint save 12-18 months, (3) controlled exposure makes the platform more attractive to pharma partners, (4) the mechanism is eShunt-specific (competitors can't replicate on VP shunts). The main risk: the 327% is model-derived and tissue concentration may not reach therapeutic threshold for all agents.
